name: is1-bot
description: IS-1 Telegram bot: IS-1 FREE download and IS-1 PRO sales for Telegram Stars / USDT

BOT_TOKEN.description: Token of your bot from **@BotFather** (`/newbot`). Looks like `123456789:AA...`.

WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Random string of letters, digits, `_` and `-` (16+ chars). Use the one from `webhook_secret.txt`. Keep it — you need it for `/setup` and `/claim`.

DB.description: Storage for file ids, purchases and settings. Created automatically.

PRICE_USD.description: Regular IS-1 PRO price in USD.

SALE_PRICE_USD.description: Sale price in USD (leave empty for no sale).

SALE_UNTIL.description: When the sale ends (ISO time), e.g. `2027-01-01T00:00:00+03:00`.

PROMO_CODES.description: Promo codes as `code=price`, comma separated, e.g. `salychmusic=7.99`.

STARS_PER_USD.description: How many Telegram Stars per 1 USD (≈ what buyers pay per Star).
